mapper.select: SELECT s.store_name AS storeName, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(od.current_quantity) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.store_id = s.store_id AND od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id AND od.order_status = '승인' AND od.store_at IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS currentQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit FROM stores s, ingredients i WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND i.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId};

SELECT s.store_name AS storeName, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, i.order_unit AS orderUnit, i.capacity AS capacity, i.capacity_unit AS capacityUnit, i.storage_type AS storageType, i.management_method AS managementMethod, i.expiration_period AS expirationPeriod, i.consumption_period AS consumptionPeriod, i.summer_consumption_period AS summerConsumptionPeriod FROM stores s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id JOIN ingredients i ON i.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId};

SELECT od.manufacture_at AS manufactureAt, DATE_ADD(od.manufacture_at, INTERVAL i.expiration_period DAY) AS expirationDate, od.store_at AS storeAt, od.order_quantity AS orderQuantity, i.order_unit AS orderUnit FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND od.ingredient_id = #{ingredientId} AND od.order_status = '승인' AND od.store_at IS NOT NULL
